title: Nanofluid wetting of Cu enables thin <mark>lithium</mark> negative electrodes for high-energy and long-cycling <mark>lithium</mark> metal batteries
abstract: Published online: 07 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-79376-x <mark>Lithium</mark> metal batteries face trade-offs between <mark>energy density</mark> and cycling life owing to <mark>lithium</mark> processability and plating challenges. title: Coupling electrolyte mechanical reinforcement and interfacial stress relaxation for near-ambient sulfide <mark>all-solid-state</mark> <mark>lithium</mark> metal batteries
abstract: Published online: 07 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-79393-w <mark>All-solid-state</mark> <mark>lithium</mark> metal batteries can suffer from <mark>dendrite</mark> growth and interfacial stress at low pressures.
